# Secret Config

> Secret Config is centralized configuration and secrets management for Ruby and Rails applications. It reads a tree of settings from a provider (AWS SSM Parameter Store, AWS Secrets Manager, or a local YAML file) into memory at startup and serves them through a global `SecretConfig` singleton, so every lookup after startup is an in-memory hash read. Environment variables can override any individual setting.

Key facts:

- Install with `gem install secret_config` or `gem "secret_config"` in a Gemfile. Requires Ruby 3.2 or later.
- Keys are paths, such as `mysql/host`, read relative to a root path such as `/production/my_application`. Providers deal in absolute keys; the registry strips the root before caching.
- All values are stored as strings. `fetch` applies, in order: environment variable override, `encoding:` (`:base64`), then `type:` (`:string`, `:integer`, `:float`, `:boolean`, `:symbol`, `:json`), with `separator:` splitting one value into an array.
- Any setting can be overridden by an environment variable named after the key, upcased, with `/` replaced by `_`: `mysql/host` becomes `MYSQL_HOST`.
- The `secret-config` command line tool imports, exports, diffs and edits the central store. It runs against a local file with `--provider file`, needing no AWS credentials.
- The AWS SDK is not a dependency. Add `aws-sdk-ssm` to use the SSM provider, or `aws-sdk-secretsmanager` to use the Secrets Manager provider.
- Human-readable documentation lives at https://config.reidmorrison.com. The links below point at the raw markdown sources of the same pages.
- The complete documentation concatenated into a single file: https://config.reidmorrison.com/llms-full.txt
- Source code: https://github.com/reidmorrison/secret_config

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/index.md): What Secret Config is, the problem it solves, and a quick start that runs from a local file with no AWS account.
- [Getting Started](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/guide.md): Installing, creating `config/application.yml`, reading a first setting, and converting an existing `database.yml` or a library's custom config file.
- [Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/api.md): The full programming interface, taught in twelve steps: `fetch` and `[]`, defaults and blocks, `type:`, `separator:`, `encoding:`, environment variable overrides, `key?`, `configuration`, `SecretConfig.configure`, `refresh!`, filters, and writing values. Ends with troubleshooting.
- [Configuration](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/config.md): `SecretConfig.use` options, choosing a root path, `check_env_var`, `interpolate:`, filters, and the `SECRET_CONFIG_*` environment variables that change startup behavior.
- [Providers](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/providers.md): The file provider (layout, ERB, writing, errors), the SSM provider (KMS keys, options, retries and throttling, IAM policy, limits and cost) and the Secrets Manager provider, which is beta (how the tree is loaded, writing, scheduled deletes, naming, IAM policy, limits and cost), plus how to write a custom provider.
- [Interpolation and Imports](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/interpolation.md): `${...}` tokens for environment variables, host name, date, random and select values; `$${...}` escaping; `__import__` for sharing subtrees; and `__value__` for a node that is both a value and a branch.
- [Command Line](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/cli.md): The `secret-config` tool, taught as workflows: inspecting a store, editing single keys, importing, diffing before importing, exporting, copying a path to spin up a tenant, generating per-tenant passwords with `__generate__`, and rotating a KMS key.
- [Rails](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/rails.md): Setup in `application.rb`, converting `database.yml`, sharing one settings file across engines, container deployment, and worked examples for Semantic Logger, ActionMailer and Symmetric Encryption.
- [Testing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/testing.md): Giving a test suite its own settings, overriding one setting for one test, using an in-memory provider, and restoring global state between tests.

## Optional

- [Upgrading](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/docs/upgrading.md): Breaking changes per major version, including the v2 changes to `key?`, environment variable caching and `fetch` blocks, and the `$(random)` to `__generate__` rename.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/README.md): Project overview and links.
- [CHANGELOG](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/reidmorrison/secret_config/main/CHANGELOG.md): The complete change record.
